# **DO NOT edit locale files** except `ja-JP.yml`.

This directory contains the translations used by the client. Translations used by the server (e.g. emails) are in [/locales-backend](../locales-backend).

When you add text to the ja-JP file (of misskey-dev/misskey), it will automatically be applied to other language files.
Translations added in ja-JP file should contain the original Japanese strings.

Please see [Contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information.
